article.headline: LIU knocks off Stonehill 66-63
article.description: — Greg Gordon and Jamal Fuller each scored 20 points to help LIU defeat Stonehill 66-63 on Friday.

categories.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Stonehill Skyhawks

event.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Stonehill Skyhawks

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Stonehill Skyhawks
article.story: SOUTH EASTON, Mass. -- — Greg Gordon and Jamal Fuller each scored 20 points to help LIU defeat Stonehill 66-63 on Friday. Gordon also added six rebounds for the Sharks (12-8, 6-1 Northeast Conference). Fuller shot 7 for 13 (4 for 8 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line. Jomo Goings shot 2 of 7 from the field and went 6 for 6 from the line to finish with 10 points, while adding three blocks. The Skyhawks (6-14, 3-4) were led by Chas Stinson, who posted 20 points and two steals. Stonehill also got 13 points from Hermann Koffi. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
